RUN IS ON TIME: slot 02:00 MYT, observation 02:03:59 MYT (18:03:59Z), research sweep 18:05:08Z, requote 18:08:14Z, decision written 02:09 MYT / 18:09Z - nine minutes after the slot, well inside the 45-minute window. An entry was therefore permitted by the clock and is refused on the evidence and the geometry. THE 00:00 NOTE SET THREE TASKS AND ALL THREE ARE ANSWERED, WITH THE LEAD SIGNAL OF THE LAST TWO CHECKS DYING IN THE PROCESS. (1) THE 4H ASCENDING-LOW SEQUENCE IS INTACT AND HAS EXTENDED. The 00:00 note called this the backbone of the entire long case and asked for it to be re-read from scratch after the 1.5633 break. (2) THE DERIVATIVES LEG IS GONE - THE SINGLE MOST IMPORTANT FINDING OF THIS CHECK. The 00:00 note named XRPUSDT's deepening funding discount, -0.008393% to -0.016553% in one hour, as 'the single most directional thing on the board' and left the third settlement as the 09:00 read. It did not survive to 09:00. The live predicted rate read -0.000601% at 18:05:08Z and -0.000078% at 18:08:14Z: the discount has decayed 99.5% in roughly two hours and is now indistinguishable from zero. It is still nominally the only negative rate in the complex (ETH +0.010000%, SOL +0.010000%, BTC +0.003891%, BNB +0.001656%), but a -0.0001% rate is not a squeeze signal and I decline to claim it as one. THE SETTLED HISTORY ALSO CORRECTS THE 00:00 NOTE'S FRAMING: the last four settlements are +0.010000% (09-21 16:00Z), -0.006889% (09-22 00:00Z), +0.010000% (08:00Z), -0.017407% (16:00Z) - the sign ALTERNATED twice. That is not a discount 'persisting through breakout, failure and reclaim'; it is an oscillation, and the 00:00 note over-read a two-point trend. XRPUSDT LONG THEREFORE CARRIES TWO SUPPORTING CATEGORIES, NOT THREE: trend and market_context. (3) THE SPAN SCREEN WAS RUN FIRST, BEFORE ANY RATIO, AND IT FAILS ON EVERY CONTRACT. N for XRPUSDT (largest 5m range of the preceding hour) = 0.506% using the 17:00-18:00Z clock hour, 0.447% on the last twelve closed bars; I used the conservative 0.506%. Required clean structural span = 2.5N + ~0.14% round-trip drag = ~1.41%. From 1.5704 the ENTIRE structural span available to a long is 1.5617 (17:00Z 1h low) to 1.5876 (24h high) = 1.659%, and the noise-safe version 1.5475 to 1.5876 = 2.592%. Now run it with the NEAREST structural target as the 00:00 note demanded rather than letting the target float: stop 1.5617 / target 1.5731 pays net 0.058; stop 1.5617 / target 1.5762 pays 0.413; stop 1.5475 / target 1.5762 pays 0.157; stop 1.5475 / target 1.5876 pays 0.655. EVERY NEAREST-TARGET CONSTRUCTION FAILS, MOST OF THEM BY AN ORDER OF MAGNITUDE. EXACTLY ONE CONSTRUCTION CLEARS THE 1.5 FLOOR AND IT IS THE TARGET-STRETCHED ONE: stop 1.5617 (0.554% risk, 1.09x N, so L-002 does NOT reject it) with target 1.5876 pays net 1.724 - and it passes ONLY because 1.5876 sits beyond FOUR intervening 1h highs that have each already rejected within the last five hours (1.5827 at 15:00Z, 1.5762 at 16:00Z, 1.5746 at 17:00Z, 1.5731 at 18:00Z). THE 00:00 NOTE IDENTIFIED TARGET-STRETCHING RETROSPECTIVELY ON FOUR CONSTRUCTIONS AND SENT IT TO THE REVIEW; THIS IS THE FIRST TIME THE SCREEN HAS BEEN APPLIED PROSPECTIVELY TO DISQUALIFY THE CHECK'S OWN BEST CANDIDATE, AND IT IS THE ONLY THING STANDING BETWEEN THIS EXPERIMENT AND A 1.724 ENTRY THAT L-002 WOULD HAVE WAVED THROUGH. L-002 AND L-003 THEN FIRED IN SEQUENCE ON THAT SAME CONSTRUCTION INSIDE 186 SECONDS - THE CLEANEST JOINT DEMONSTRATION OF THE TWO LESSONS SO FAR. Same stop 1.5617, same target 1.5876: at 18:05:08Z (ask 1.5704) risk 0.554% = 1.09x N and net RR 1.724; at 18:08:14Z (ask 1.5680) risk 0.402% = 0.79x N and net RR 2.761. THE RATIO ROSE 60% PURELY BECAUSE PRICE FELL 0.153% ONTO ITS FIXED STOP - L-003 verbatim, fourth reproduction, second consecutive check on the long side - AND THE SAME DRIFT CARRIED THE STOP FROM MARGINALLY NOISE-SAFE (1.09x N) TO SUB-NOISE (0.79x N), SO L-002 NOW REJECTS OUTRIGHT WHAT IT PERMITTED THREE MINUTES EARLIER. L-003 caught the drift; the drift then handed the rejection to L-002. THE PREMISE BROKE IN THE SAME 186 SECONDS: the requote at 1.5678/1.5680 puts price BACK BELOW the 1.5701 pivot for the THIRD time (lost 16:12:58Z, reclaimed, lost again now), so price_action for the long is not merely ambiguous, it is negative. PRICE_ACTION IS COMPRESSION, CLAIMED FOR NEITHER SIDE: five consecutive lower 1h highs (1.5876 -> 1.5827 -> 1.5762 -> 1.5746 -> 1.5731) against rising lows since 16:00Z (1.5475 -> 1.5617 -> 1.5677) - a coil tightening onto the pivot, directionally mute. VOLUME EXAMINED AND EXPLICITLY NOT CLAIMED, FOURTH CONSECUTIVE CHECK: the 1h series is a flat band again (13:00Z 6066.6M, 14:00Z 5707.5M, 15:00Z 5538.9M, 16:00Z 5739.9M, 17:00Z 6009.2M) and the 5m recovery off 1.5617 averaged ~500M against a 350.6M selloff bar - no expansion, no drying up. XRPUSDT SHORT IS THE MIRROR AND FAILS THE EVIDENCE BAR: ONE category (price_action, the five lower highs), with trend against it, market_context against it, and funding now marginally against it too since a short pays a negative rate. One is not two. BNBUSDT SHORT WAS THE ONLY OTHER TWO-CATEGORY CANDIDATE AND FAILS THE SAME SPAN SCREEN PLUS A LIQUIDITY TEST. AND THE BOOK INDEPENDENTLY DISQUALIFIES IT - SEE THE NEW BOOK-INSTABILITY FINDING BELOW.
